configuration.title: Herdr Collie
config.hideHerdrSidebar: Hide Herdr's built-in sidebar (spaces and agents) when running in VS Code terminal
config.sessionName: Session name to use when launching Herdr from VS Code terminal (e.g. 'vscode')
config.worktreeLocation: Where to create Git worktrees when launching swarm agents ('sibling' directory or '.worktrees' subfolder)
config.agentHUD.enableNotifications: Show interactive notifications when an agent requires approval or completes a task
config.agentHUD.autoVerifyDiagnostics: Closed-loop verification when an agent finishes a task: 'prompt' (offer button to send remaining VS Code errors back), 'auto' (automatically send errors back up to max retries), or 'off'
config.agentHUD.autoVerifyMaxRetries: Maximum number of automatic diagnostic verification retries when 'agentHUD.autoVerifyDiagnostics' is set to 'auto'
config.defaultAgentCommand: Default AI agent command to launch in worktrees (e.g. 'claude', 'agy', 'cursor', 'gh copilot')
config.agentSortOrder: Sort order for active agents in the Agents sidebar: 'grouped' (by workspace) or 'priority' (by urgency/attention queue)
config.reviewChanges.viewMode: Display mode for the Review Changes sidebar view: 'tree' (hierarchical compact folders) or 'flat' (flat file list)
config.codeLens.enable: Show inline CodeLens above test definitions and TODO comments to trigger AI agent assistance
config.quickFix.enable: Show 'Delegate Fix to Herdr Agent' Quick-Fix action in Lightbulb menu for compiler/linter diagnostics
config.autoRestoreTerminal: Automatically restore and re-attach Herdr in terminals preserved across VS Code restarts
config.terminal.failureAction: Action when a VS Code terminal command exits with a non-zero status (Shell Integration): 'prompt' (notification & status bar QuickFix), 'statusbar' (status bar badge only), or 'off'
config.worktree.conflictRadar: Automatically scan Git worktrees for overlapping file edits and surface conflict radar badges and warnings
config.worktree.copyFiles: Relative file paths (such as '.env' or '.env.local') to automatically copy from the main repository into newly created Git worktrees if present
config.worktree.postCreateCommand: Optional shell command to run inside a newly created Git worktree right after provisioning (e.g. 'pnpm install --prefer-offline')
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Herdr Collie requires local filesystem access for Git worktrees, CLI execution, and Unix domain sockets.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Automatic Herdr daemon startup, workspace binding, terminal auto-restore, postCreateCommand execution, and agent/Git-modifying commands require Workspace Trust.
